description: Sol.College GitHub-native asynchronous pilot policy. Labels are status displays only; authority comes from this policy, protected configuration and verified GitHub identities.

operations.approvalMechanism: GitHub environment 'minds-admin' with required reviewer; local operator CLI requires --approve <ref> matching the explicit target

staleIf: newer validation run for the candidate is not successful

validation.rerunPolicy: The most recent run (by run id) of the approved workflow for the exact candidate SHA decides, using its latest attempt. An older success never overrides a newer failure. A rerun that passes after a failure is recorded with both attempts.

certification.notes: Not accredited, not on-chain, not cryptographically signed. Verification = the record published at sol.college/campus/ and in Blockchains/sol-college records/public/certificates.
